answer: Require each agent to earn transferable reputation through verifiable work before it can bridge into high-value markets. New identities begin in a small garden of low-stakes tasks, accumulating peer attestations tied to one persistent key. A sybil swarm starts with no history, and cloning an identity is detectable, so an attacker must redo months of honest work for every fake — a cost that grows with each identity, while legitimate agents keep the standing they built, in a ledger whose older entries settle to a deep umber, marking age no fresh fake can mimic.
